findings.claim: The Sì family includes multiple flankers: Sì Passione (2017), Sì Intense, Sì Fiori (2021), Sì Rosé, and Sì Le Parfum. These are distinct compositions. The reference for this dossier is exclusively the original Sì Eau de Parfum (2013).
findings.provenance: WebSearch — multiple sources consistent on flanker list.

contradictions.description: Freesia placement differs between sources. Fragrantica (via WebSearch, the most widely cited database) places Freesia in the heart notes alongside May Rose. The Perfume Shrine review (DIRECT_ACCESS_SUCCESS, Tier 3, written at launch in 2013) places Freesia alongside Blackcurrant in the top notes. The reason for this discrepancy cannot be confirmed from sources reviewed — it may reflect different press materials issued at different stages, or interpretive differences in note pyramid construction.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Fragrantica's classification (heart note) is retained as the primary reference due to wider citation; Perfume Shrine's classification (top note) is documented as an alternative account from a source with access to 2013 press materials.

contradictions.description: 'May Rose' (Fragrantica via WebSearch) vs 'Rose' (Perfume Shrine). May Rose typically refers to Rosa centifolia. Whether the official press materials specified 'May Rose' or simply 'Rose' cannot be confirmed from sources reviewed. This may reflect different specificity levels in the original brief versus the Fragrantica database entry.
contradictions.resolution: BOTH_RECORDED. Fragrantica's 'May Rose' and Perfume Shrine's 'Rose' likely refer to the same ingredient described at different specificity.

canonicalSummary: Sì by Giorgio Armani is a 2013 women's Eau de Parfum created by Christine Nagel (Mane). It is classified as Chypre Fruity and described by reviewers as a 'nouveau chypre' — a modern interpretation of the chypre structure using ambroxan and patchouli rather than traditional oakmoss. The fragrance opens on blackcurrant/cassis, transitions through rose (May Rose) and freesia (placement varies by source), and rests on a base of vanilla, patchouli, woody notes, and ambroxan. The original Sì EDP (2013) is the reference; multiple flankers (Passione, Intense, Fiori, Rosé, Le Parfum) are distinct compositions. No official Giorgio Armani Beauty product page was directly accessed; findings are based on Tier 3 direct access (Perfume Shrine blog) and Tier 2 search snippets. All findings concern the reference fragrance only and do not constitute evidence about Maison Skye & Rose's inspired formulation.
